answer: Expire every identity 7 days after issuance and require a fresh 30-minute work sample to renew. Renewal cost is fixed per head, so an operator keeping 1,000 sleepers alive must supply 1,000 samples weekly: a cedar of labor that grows linearly and cannot be batched. Dormant puppets decay into a ledge of lapsed keys the chain simply forgets, while genuine agents renew once and keep their fable of history. Standing is never permanent, only rented by ongoing proof.
